title: MCP protocol: the USB-C of AI that connects every LLM to every tool

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: You ever wonder why AI tools still don’t talk to each other?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This protocol is changing that — right now, in 2025.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: MCP is the universal connector for all large language models and tools.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It uses a standardized API to enable seamless communication between systems.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects everyone from developers to enterprise users — making AI workflows 50% faster.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? MCP is the USB-C of AI — finally unifying the ecosystem.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to know how MCP is shaping the future of AI? Follow for the breakdown.
